items.question: Can the learning be tailored to our organisation?
items.answer: That is the starting point. We discuss your audience, tools, real tasks and existing materials, then agree the content and formats that fit your goals.

items.question: Can content work with our existing learning platform?
items.answer: We review your platform and its technical requirements before proposing a format. Any integration, tracking or accessibility requirements are agreed as part of the scope.

items.question: Who can use the content, and can we update it?
items.answer: We agree usage rights, access to source materials and how updates will be handled in the proposal, so the handover is clear before production begins.

items.question: How much time do we need to contribute?
items.answer: You help define the goals, provide subject knowledge and review the work at agreed stages. We set out the input and review time needed once the scope is clear.

items.question: What does a learning project cost?
items.answer: The cost depends on the content, production, formats and technical requirements. We discuss the brief first and then propose a defined scope.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: The schedule depends on the amount of content, access to subject experts and review rounds. We agree milestones and responsibilities together before starting.
